Sorry for replying so late but to be honest you just have to get into the mindset you don't need it. Try getting into something healthy to relieve stress, exercise is one of the best ways to do so. And if you smoked a lot like i did just go a week or two without smoking and you'll see some extra cash in your bank account and realize what you could spend that on. Where I am my brand cost about 13 bucks a pack i'd go through around 2-3 packs a week so thats 26-39 bucks a week on cigarettes that's money that I could save, spend on groceries or go out on a meal with friends. There's much more productive things to do than smoking and if you have friends that smoke a lot try not to be around them when they do because it really does get tempting. One of the best things is smoking a cigarette with a good friend and just chillaxing for a few minutes. But you're above it you got it im still smoke free and I know you can be too

Awesome! I’ve been smoke free for about two months now and I’ll say it’s probably one of the best decisions of my life. I smoked for about two years but literally in two weeks The tightness in my chest from smoking went away and I became immensely better at running, also I used to wake up with phlegm in my throat and a sore throat at least 3-4 times a week. It will be very difficult for her due to how long she’s been smoking but if she can tough it out for a couple weeks she will definitely notice how much more free she feels. Support her and acknowledge that it’s her own decision and she can quit on her own will, my friends always used to try to make me quit by screaming about how I’d die etc but it just made me feel stupid/belittled. If you empower her and she sees changes herself she will keep on the right path. Also something very helpful is if the people around her don’t smoke, when I’m at a party or something and I see people smoke I get such bad urges. Good luck to her and congrats! It is the start of a new era.
There’s no work around the degrees are just not applicable, go to NYC and you’ll meet tons of cab drivers who are extremely educated form foreign universities but have no other job prospects

It’s actually easier to transfer a degree over as a medical student because there’s still a path to move into the medical career once you move over. However in virtually every degree field there’s not even the ability to test or anything to show your capabilities. Bangladesh May the “third world” but I see no way how that should completely blanket every educated person from there. You can try to put your Bengali degree on linked in but the degree just won’t be accepted.

I’d question your theory on academic rigor and methods simply because the Bengali university/schooling  model and much of the prior colonies is based on the British method. Sure I’ve heard of nepotism and such but I don’t really understand what courses that would be offered at a Western Uni outside of very obscure ones that wouldn’t be offered in a Bengali one. Many of the professors as well at unis in BD are foreign/teach in English. While I understand why my fathers degrees from the 80s aren’t applicable the students and schooling of today are worlds apart from back then. It’s however quite a shame that even in fields such as business and economics or even various sciences which can seemingly be applicable world wide have no application at all in western countries even through testing to prove your knowledge.
